result.brief: 论文诊断视频 LLM 计数失败源于表征可解码但读出失效，并提出事件符号侧通道与片段定位监督修复读出，附带表征探针分析。
result.reason: Diagnoses representation-readout dissociation in video LLMs with linear probes and event-symbol side channels; touches video representation learning but targets counting readout, not world modeling or generation.
